prompt_en: Stage a two-adult aerial wuxia duel inside a bamboo action corridor at misty dawn. Give the lead long near-black wavy hair with a center part, a softly oval face, warm brown eyes, straight brows, and natural closed lips. Show two complete, unmistakably adult swordswomen in a bamboo-forest aerial duel across three depth layers: foreground leaves, the fighters above a silver stream, and receding green trunks. Vertical bamboo trunks at multiple depths create one open lateral and vertical action corridor around the suspended fighters. Two complete adult martial silhouettes remain separately readable without overlap or body merging, with coherent hands, feet, and robes. The rivals occupy opposed rising descending or lateral paths within the same bamboo depth axis, with the lead cutting downward from camera right while the rival rises from camera left. One shared martial exchange point and separate branch ground or landing anchors remain visible for both fighters, joining blade contact to reachable destinations. Their blades meet at one crisp, readable steel contact point; a mossed boulder anchors the lead, and an arched root shelf anchors the rival. The scene remains a two-person bamboo-owned duel rather than a portrait generic forest sparring or free-floating immortal tableau, with visible descent geometry. Use a wide 50 mm lateral frame; pale dawn backlight and mist droplets share one ravine atmosphere, with restrained robe motion, sharp faces, and photoreal bamboo, water, steel, and cloth.
